formats.importDelimited: Import a CSV or TSV file
formats.importDelimitedDesc: One row per scene. Columns are found by header name.
formats.importMarkdown: Import a folder of Markdown or Ulysses sheets
formats.importMarkdownDesc: Subfolders become chapters; each file becomes a scene.
formats.importScrivenerDesc: Folders in the binder become chapters; the text documents inside them become scenes.
